scope: A precise counterexample to unrestricted smooth recovery of relative non-pluripolar adjoints. On P1 x P1 an admissible unbounded ordinary model type has singleton support dV and the meaningful residual adjoint beta/4. Two monotone, uniformly positive smooth regularizations converge canonically, in capacity and smoothly off the pole divisor, with log-densities converging in all finite Lp, but have different normalized classical adjoint probability limits, each placing mass one half on the divisor. Fixed-type, mass-preserving or uniformly integrable-exponential extensions are not refuted; broader S07 remains open.
status: Accepted, mathematically assessed, compiled and visually inspected; publication pending.

native_source_report_preserved_unchanged.report:
All three supplied premise strings are established, with their stated hypotheses and applications.

Premise 0 follows from [Demailly, Theorem I.5.24](https://www-fourier.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/~demailly/manuscripts/agbook.pdf). An analytic hypersurface is locally pluripolar, using log|g| for a local defining function. The unique canonical extension equals the stated limsup; local upper and lower bounds persist. This applies to the bounded remainders after adding local potentials of beta.

For premise 1, [Aubin, Theorem 4.13](https://www.kfki.hu/~iracz/sgimp/cikkek/nlinear_Problems_in_Riemannian_Geometry__Springer_Monographs_in_Mathematics_.pdf) uses the opposite Laplacian sign. Negating its kernel gives the supplied representation and distributional equation. Its uniform lower bound and integrable diagonal estimates allow a constant shift making the negated kernel nonpositive with uniformly bounded absolute integrals. [Grigor’yan, Sections 2.2–2.4](https://www.math.uni-bielefeld.de/~grigor/noteps.pdf) establishes the positive heat kernel and spectral semigroup. These imply commutation with Delta, preservation of constants and of Delta f >= -A. The pointwise assertion also follows: S_t f+At increases with t, so its limit as t decreases to zero is upper semicontinuous and equals f almost everywhere. Canonical quasi-psh representatives give the lower inequality everywhere; positivity and concentration of the heat kernel, together with upper semicontinuity, give the reverse inequality. Thus the limit is the canonical f at every point. No preservation of plurisubharmonicity by heat flow is required.

For premise 2, bounded products, multilinearity and positivity are established in [Boucksom–Guedj–Lu, Section 3.1](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s42543-025-00105-2). [BEGZ, Theorem 1.14](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~guedj/fichierspdf/BEGZ10.pdf), with A empty and the closed positive current Θ=T+alpha, gives the asserted integration-by-parts formula. Multilinearity gives T²-alpha²=dd^c w wedge Θ; testing the formula against smooth functions identifies this with dd^c(wΘ). Stokes yields both mass identities. Locally adding a smooth potential of eta to f proves the stated mixed-product lower bound. The cutoff is bounded quasi-psh, and its negative is handled by linearity, so the note’s use is valid.

The geometric constants, admissibility check, divisor cutoff, scalar integration and support differentiation are consistent with these results and the task-granted solvability. Approval preserves the note’s restricted conclusion: the explicit singular target and its adjoint are verified; recovery by arbitrary smooth approximations is not asserted or established.

passages.statement: Let U be a domain in C^m and H an analytic hypersurface in U. If q is plurisubharmonic on U\H and locally bounded above near H, its extension to H by limsup from U\H is plurisubharmonic on U and is the unique extension with the canonical upper representative. If q is locally bounded both above and below near H, this extension is locally bounded.

passages.statement: On a connected compact Riemannian manifold M without boundary, with Laplacian Delta=div grad and Riemannian volume dmu, there is a Green kernel G satisfying Delta_y G(x,y)=delta_x-1/Vol(M). Its additive constant can be chosen so that G<=0 and sup_x integral_M |G(x,y)|dmu(y)<infinity. For every smooth real f, f(x)-Vol(M)^(-1)integral_M f dmu=integral_M G(x,y)Delta f(y)dmu(y). On a compact Kähler manifold, the positivity-preserving Laplacian heat semigroup commutes with Delta and converges pointwise to the canonical representative of every bounded quasi-plurisubharmonic function; in particular a distributional lower bound Delta f>=-A is preserved by this regularization.

Let X be a compact Kähler surface, alpha a smooth closed Kähler form, and w a bounded canonical alpha-plurisubharmonic function. Put T=alpha+dd^c w and use bounded Bedford–Taylor products. Then T^2 and its mixed products with smooth closed semipositive forms are positive, T^2-alpha^2=dd^c(w(T+alpha)), and integral_X T^2=integral_X alpha^2. For every bounded canonical quasi-plurisubharmonic f, the signed mixed product dd^c f wedge (T+alpha) is defined and integral_X f(T^2-alpha^2)=integral_X w dd^c f wedge (T+alpha). If dd^c f>=-eta for a smooth closed semipositive form eta, this mixed product is bounded below by -eta wedge (T+alpha), and integral_X eta wedge T=integral_X eta wedge alpha.

root_math_assessment: A logarithmic divisor on P1 x P1 has relative residual beta and mass 4 in the admissible ordinary model type. Bounded residual products and Stokes determine the scalar for every bounded density; Jensen and two-sided differentiation give singleton supports. Constant weight 1/4 gives a precisely defined weak residual adjoint and its smooth-test linearization. The exact chain rule makes both regularization families uniformly positive with smooth class mass 8 and normalized classical weights 1/8. Direct normal integrals in the independently reconstructed proof, and rescaled normal spikes in the original proof, agree on the divisor coefficients 4 omega2 plus dd^c g. Both probability limits charge the divisor with mass one half and differ for nonconstant g. The common current limit has a divisorial component and cannot be an ordinary locally integrable function times the smooth non-pluripolar residual. Cutoffs verify capacity convergence; logarithmic domination gives all finite Lp density convergence while exponential mass fails to converge. The article replaces the original valid Green/heat envelope proof with explicit radial convexity and cites the exact global bounded integration theorem. No general, fixed-type or mass-preserving failure is inferred.
root_editorial_deltas: Replace the compact Green estimate for this particular model with a direct radial convex envelope formula: W=x+2log2 on x<=0 and W=2log(1+exp x) on x>=0. Invariance under first rotations and the transitive second SU2 action gives the exact obstacle-envelope proof.
Spell out the cutoff capacity estimate with constant 2/t.
Preserve all fixed-type, mass-preserving and uniform-exponential-integrability limitations.
Add the exact BEGZ Theorem 1.14 global bounded integration citation after reading its full printed proof.
